messages:
maya: PR #5499 updates the pricing page to mention floor pricing for tiny requests. We need a tiny Go SDK snippet showing how to compute minutes->allowance and a one-line migration note for legacy headers. cc @trent @sora
trent: I can do the Go snippet. Keep it 5 lines. Should show flooring behavior (we floor to whole tokens).
sora: Also add a brief alert YAML example that triggers at 90% of daily allowance and a sentence about burst credits excluded until consumed.
maya: Good: show the formula `allowance = per_min * minutes` and then note enforcement floors to whole tokens; display still shows two decimals for cost estimates.
trent: Go snippet (draft):```go
// compute allowance for minutes, floor to int
func Allowance(perMin float64, minutes int) int {
  return int(math.Floor(perMin*float64(minutes)))
}
```
sora: Alert YAML:```yaml
when: usage.percent_of_daily >= 90
window: 30m
action: notify.billing
notes: burst credits excluded until consumed
```
docs-bot: l10n-check queued for PR #5499. Please avoid internal console links in docs.
maya: Migration line (one-liner): "Legacy meter header users: map to X-Redwood-Usage-Tier and recompute per_min/per_day allowances."
trent: I'll push the PR with the Go snippet and migration line; thanks!
